use_case_name: Prioritize reachable dependency findings in Payments
customer_problem: Payments AppSec needs to identify which third-party dependency findings to fix and shorten remediation time.
supported_workflow: Organization-approved GitHub App, phased repository onboarding and reachability-based dependency triage.
adoption_definition: Share of agreed repositories with a successful dependency scan in the preceding 30 days.
success_measure: Median days to remediate resolved dependency findings in the actively scanned Payments scope.
problem_addressed: Dependency scanners can create more alerts than developers can act on. Reachability gives application context for which findings to review and fix first.

use_case_name: Prioritize Clinical dependency findings using reachability
customer_problem: Clinical AppSec needs to prioritize dependency findings and close them within its remediation SLA.

adoption_definition: Share of agreed repositories with a successful dependency scan in the preceding 30 days.
success_measure: Share of measured dependency findings in scanned Clinical Platform repositories resolved within SLA.
problem_addressed: Dependency scanners can create more alerts than developers can act on. Reachability gives application context for which findings to review and fix first.

use_case_name: Prioritize dependency fixes in Product Security’s repositories
customer_problem: Product Security wants to reduce the time spent resolving open-source dependency findings in its contracted repositories.
supported_workflow: Scan the Product Security repository scope and use reachability in dependency remediation triage.
adoption_definition: Share of agreed repositories with a successful dependency scan in the preceding 30 days.
success_measure: Median days to remediate resolved dependency findings within the Product Security deployment.
problem_addressed: Dependency scanners can create more alerts than developers can act on. Reachability gives application context for which findings to review and fix first.

use_case_name: Standardize dependency checks in two shared CI templates
customer_problem: Platform Engineering wants teams to adopt consistent dependency checks without each service owner configuring them independently.
supported_workflow: Evaluate Endor Open Source dependency scanning and reachability output in two shared CI templates.
adoption_definition: Proposed pilot checks for successful dependency scans and actionable results from both shared templates.
success_measure: Proposed measurement is setup minutes per team before and after the pilot. Current baseline and target are pending.
problem_addressed: Dependency scanners can create more alerts than developers can act on. Reachability gives application context for which findings to review and fix first.

customer_problem: Storefront AppSec spends engineering time triaging package findings in its build images.
supported_workflow: Scan the service image built from each onboarded repository and use reachability to prioritize image findings.
adoption_definition: Share of agreed service repositories whose built image had a successful container scan in the preceding 30 days.
success_measure: Weekly team hours spent triaging Storefront container-image findings, from the team’s time log.
problem_addressed: Container images contain many packages. Image scanning and reachability help AppSec teams prioritize fixes based on what their applications use.

use_case_name: Evaluate container image scanning for Fulfillment services
customer_problem: Fulfillment wants a consistent way to prioritize image findings across service teams.
supported_workflow: Pilot scans of the images built from three Fulfillment service repositories.
adoption_definition: The proposed scope is successful image scans from three service repositories. No pilot telemetry is recorded yet.
success_measure: Proposed measurement compares weekly container-image triage time for the same service cohort.
problem_addressed: Container images contain many packages. Image scanning and reachability help AppSec teams prioritize fixes based on what their applications use.

use_case_name: Triage actionable first-party code findings in Routing
customer_problem: Routing Engineering wants actionable security findings in its own application code and shorter time to remediate them.
supported_workflow: Enable AI SAST on agreed Routing repositories, then review and route first-party code findings with engineering owners.
adoption_definition: Share of agreed Routing repositories with a successful AI SAST scan in the preceding 30 days.
success_measure: Median days to remediate resolved first-party code findings in the active Routing scope.
problem_addressed: Developers need actionable first-party code findings with enough context to triage and remediate them in their development workflow.
